title: Service request routing
problem: Requests arrive through several channels and are manually assigned
dependencies: Consistent request categories and a documented escalation path

title: Appointment reminder prioritization
problem: Staff cannot easily identify appointments with a high no-show likelihood
dependencies: Historical attendance data and a human-approved contact policy

title: Knowledge article discovery
problem: Staff spend time searching a large internal knowledge base
dependencies: Permission-aware search index and current source articles

title: Duplicate case detection
problem: Similar cases are opened repeatedly across teams
dependencies: Stable identifiers and a review queue for possible matches
